messages:
emma: Heads-up: I pushed a fresh draft of the product launch post into the editorial doc. Main asks: tighten headline, simplify benchmark language, and confirm HubSpot routing for webinar and blog CTAs. Need approvals by tomorrow AM. Link: https://docs.google.com/d/LAUNCH-DOC

gabe: skimmed the intro. Suggest swapping the headline to something more benefit-led: 'Reduce inference cost and predict latency at scale'. short and clear.

nina: +1 on benefit-led. Also, can we drop the technical p95 numbers in the hero? Save those for a 'how we measured' section.

emma: agreed. I'll make the headline: 'Reduce inference cost and predict latency at scale' and move the detailed numbers to methodology.

tasha: demand note: both CTAs (blog sign-up and webinar register) must hit HubSpot form `ri_launch_march2026`. Include these hidden fields: `lead_source=blog`, `campaign=launch_march_2026`, `interest=inference`. Also add `owner_team=demand-marketing` hidden so SDRs get routed.

ben: editorial: benchmark caption currently says '3x faster'. Legal will flag. Maybe phrasing: 'in our internal tests, throughput per GPU was roughly 3x higher versus a representative baseline.'

legal-bot: auto-scan: flagged comparative-term 'faster'. Suggest safe copy: 'In our internal benchmarks, the runtime achieved approximately three times the throughput per GPU compared with a representative baseline; results vary by workload. See methodology link for test details.'

emma: thanks legal-bot. I'll use that sentence verbatim and link to https://redwood.com/docs/benchmark-methodology in the methodology section and the caption alt text.

gabe: design request: we need an accessible alt text for the benchmark graphic. Suggest: 'Bar chart showing throughput per GPU: baseline vs Redwood runtime; higher is better.'

ben: check on the chart label: can we make it 'throughput (tokens/sec per GPU)' so readers understand metric?

nina: FYI for analytics — add UTM query: `?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=launch_march_2026`. Combine with hidden HS fields on registration links.

tasha: confirming HS form field names: `lead_source`, `campaign`, `initial_interest`, `owner_team`, `company_size`. We'll use `ri_launch_march2026` as form id. Please include snippet we can copy into the doc: `?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=launch_march_2026&lead_source=blog&campaign=launch_march_2026&initial_interest=inference&owner_team=demand-marketing`

emma: pasted the exact snippet into the CTA buttons. Also swapped the screenshot and added the alt text.

legal-bot: small flag: the line 'used in production by Fortune 500 customers'—if we don't have customer permission, change to 'used by customers in production' or name customers only if approved.

gabe: change to 'used by customers in production across a range of industries.' keeps it true and safe.

emma: updated.

ben: one more promo ask: webinar promo should include a short blurb: 'Live demo + benchmark walkthrough + Q&A' and route registrants to the same HS form so we can tag them. Nina — can you confirm the follow-up email will use the same campaign id?

nina: confirmed. follow-up emails will set campaign=launch_march_2026 and tag enterprise leads when `company_size` > 500. We have an automation: if company_size > 500 -> lifecycle_stage: sales-qualified. Add a publish checklist item to verify that flow is active before publish.

tasha: added to checklist. also note: set hidden field `company_size` on form where possible and ensure the HubSpot property mapping uses integer values.

legal-bot: final scan pass: no other comparative flags. Recommend adding the standard disclaimer: 'Benchmark test details and configuration are available in our public methodology; results may vary by workload and configuration.'

emma: inserted the disclaimer in the methodology paragraph and added a link to the doc.

gabe: product approves copy with the headline swap and the disclaimer.

ben: marketing approves. small ask: update the meta description to include 'webinar' so organic CTR helps registration.

nina: ops note: scheduling — can we go live Wednesday 9am PDT? That gives 48 hours for email and paid social creative. Ops-bot, can you create the calendar event and reminder?

ops-bot: created calendar event 'Launch Post + Webinar Prep' Wed 09:00 PDT. Reminder set 24h prior. Invitees: marketing, demand, product, ops.

emma: approvals complete from product/marketing/demand/legal. I'll set the doc to final and queue publish for Wed 09:00 PDT. Leaving comments open for tiny edits only. Thanks all! :party_parrot:
